common.tagline: We record the accident — to reach the truth
common.notFoundBody: The link you opened is invalid or no longer available.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this page.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.rateLimitedNoDelay: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Enter your phone number and we'll text you a verification code.
auth.phoneHint: A Syrian number starting with 09, 10 digits total.
auth.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Syrian number starting with 09 (10 digits).
auth.fullNameHint: Required the first time you sign in with this number.
auth.fullNameTooLong: Name is too long (120 characters maximum).
auth.devHint: In development the code is written to the server log instead of being sent by SMS.

verify.title: Verify a report
verify.subtitle: Enter the verification token printed on the report, or open the QR link directly.
verify.tokenPlaceholder: The token printed under the QR code
verify.validTitle: Valid report, issued by the platform
verify.supersededTitle: This report has been superseded by a newer one
verify.notFoundBody: Check the token, or rescan the QR code on the original report.
verify.privacyNote: For privacy, this page shows only whether the report is valid — no party names, accident details, or amounts.

home.empty: No sections are available for your current role.

vehicles.title: My vehicles
vehicles.subtitle: Add your vehicle before reporting an accident — a report is always tied to a vehicle registered in your name.

report.title: Report an accident
report.draftRestored: Picked up where you left off — your details and photos are saved on this device.

vehicle.title: Which vehicle was in the accident?
vehicle.noVehicles: You have no registered vehicles. Add one first, then come back to your report.
vehicle.occurredAtHint: An approximate date and time is fine.
vehicle.injuryWarning: Accidents with injuries are referred to the competent authority, and your report stays on file. Call emergency services immediately if anyone is seriously hurt.

location.title: Where did it happen?
location.denied: Could not access your location. Enter the coordinates manually, or allow location access in your browser settings.
location.unsupported: Your browser does not support geolocation. Enter the coordinates manually.
location.manualHint: On a weak connection you can type the coordinates and adjust them later.

photos.title: Photograph the scene
photos.subtitle: Four photos minimum. Follow the guide frame on each card.
photos.extraHint: Optional — add anything that makes the scene clearer.

wide.label: Wide shot
wide.hint: Step back and capture the whole scene, including the road and any signs.

vehicles.label: Both vehicles
vehicles.hint: Show how the vehicles sit relative to each other and to the lane markings.

damage.label: Damage close-up
damage.hint: Get close enough that the damage fills the frame.

plate.label: Number plate
plate.hint: Capture the plate sharp and fully readable.

counterparty.title: Who was the other party?
counterparty.subtitle: We'll text them a link to add their side to the same case.
counterparty.plateHint: Optional, but it speeds up verification.
counterparty.hitAndRun: The other party left the scene (hit and run)
counterparty.hitAndRunHint: Choose this and we won't ask for their details; the case is referred to the competent authority.

statement.title: Tell us what happened
statement.label: Your statement
statement.placeholder: Describe it in your own words: which way you were going, roughly how fast, and what the other party did.

errors.occurredAtRequired: Enter the date and time of the accident.
errors.occurredAtFuture: The accident time cannot be in the future.
errors.photosRequired: All four guided photos are required.
errors.counterpartyPhoneRequired: Enter the other party's phone number, or choose hit and run.
errors.statementRequired: Write your statement of what happened.
errors.statementTooLong: The statement is longer than 2000 characters.
errors.submitFailed: Could not send the report. Your details are saved — try again.

success.title: Your report has been received
success.keepNumber: Keep this number — it's how you follow your case at every step.

fast_track.label: Fast track
fast_track.body: Your details are enough to handle this remotely. The other party gets a link to add their account, then the liability decision is issued.

dispatch_required.label: Surveyor dispatch
dispatch_required.body: A field surveyor will be sent to inspect the accident. You'll get a text when the visit is scheduled.

police_required.label: Referred to the authority
police_required.body: This accident needs an official report from the competent authority. Your report is documented and will be linked to theirs when it arrives.

hero.eyebrow: A national platform for traffic accidents and motor insurance
hero.title: From the accident scene
hero.subtitle: Document the accident yourself in minutes, then follow the liability decision and your insurance claim step by step — fully transparent, with no waiting at the roadside.

items.label: Target time to report from your phone
Report issued on the fast track
Window to object to a liability decision

problem.title: A minor accident, a long road
problem.body: Today an accident starts with waiting at the roadside, continues with paperwork carried by hand between the parties, and ends in an ad-hoc liability call and a claim with no clear date.
points: Traffic backs up while everyone waits for an official to reach the scene
Liability is judged case by case with no published rule
Paper evidence and scattered photos are easy to lose or swap
Insurance claims with no binding deadlines and no stated reason for rejection

steps.title: Five steps, from the road to settlement

items.title: Report and document
items.body: A guided wizard walks you through it: drop a pin on the map, take photos against on-screen guide frames, and record a voice statement in Arabic.

items.title: The other party joins
items.body: The second driver receives a signed SMS link that attaches their account to the same case — one case, two perspectives.

items.title: Triage and inspection
items.body: A rules-based triage engine decides: remote fast track, dispatch a field surveyor, or refer to the competent authority.

items.title: Liability decision
items.body: A codified liability matrix proposes the split, and a qualified reviewer confirms it with written reasoning — with a 72-hour right to object.

items.title: Report and claim
items.body: A digitally signed official report with a QR code, which automatically opens your claim with the insurer and tracks every step.

audiences.title: One platform for every party to an accident

items.title: Drivers and citizens
items.body: Self-reporting, case and claim tracking, and objections — all in one place.

items.title: Field surveyors
items.body: Zone-based assignments and evidence upload that keeps working when the network drops.

items.title: Adjudicators and the appeals panel
items.body: A structured review queue, statements compared side by side, and a rule-backed automatic proposal.

items.title: Insurance companies
items.body: Standardised reports, consistent damage estimates, and decisions with mandatory reason codes.

items.title: Regulators and traffic authorities
items.body: SLA compliance dashboards, accident heatmaps, and fraud indicators.

trust.title: Trust is built in software, not assumed
trust.body: We don't depend on complete registries or ready-made government integrations — the proof is built inside the platform itself.

items.title: Tamper-evident evidence
items.body: Every file is hashed with SHA-256 the moment it is uploaded, and is never deleted or edited; corrections add a later version while the original stays visible.

items.title: Public report verification
items.body: Scan the QR code on any report to confirm it is genuine and current — no sign-in, and no party data exposed.

items.title: Automatic fraud detection
items.body: The same image hash appearing across cases raises a flag immediately, alongside repeat-claimant and impossible-geometry signals.

items.title: Complete audit trail
items.body: Every decision and every permission change is recorded with who did it, when, and the values before and after.

finalCta.title: Your accident deserves a clear path
finalCta.body: Start a report now, or check whether a report in your hands is genuine.
